target_work.title: What do these papers tell a luxury fashion house about sustainability claims and legitimacy?
target_work.description: The five documents, read together, function as an early-warning system for a luxury house. SG4IGV3Y names the precise mechanism: for every circular-economy commitment a brand makes (repair, resell, recycle), a neoliberal counter-narrative exists that can reframe it as a profit move—and consumers have been trained to spot the seam. CW9WK9KL adds that even the academic field studying sustainable fashion is dominated by marketing logic, which means the vocabulary luxury brands borrow to talk about sustainability is already suspect in the eyes of informed critics. WUPV36YG then shows, via Twitter's hashflags, that symbolic gestures decoupled from internal governance are the single fastest path to a credibility collapse. research_question: Where Your Sustainability Claims Will Be Challenged
strategy_summary: The sequence moves from conceptual foundation to dialectical exposure to inferential consequence to pattern recognition—each phase feeding the next. Phase 1 (concept_centrality_mapper, standard) anchors the audit in the corpus's own load-bearing ideas rather than imported assumptions, as the brief demands. Phase 2 (dialectical_structure, deep) converts those concepts into live contradiction scenarios—the actual challenge moments a luxury house will face—and justifies deep depth given a 349,233-character, five-document corpus with fundamentally opposed theoretical frameworks in play. Phase 3 (inferential_commitment_mapper, standard) operationalizes the contradictions into the ranked claim-defence / claim-retirement list the executive audience needs as output. The mandatory surface pass is placed in Phase 4 (structural_pattern_detector) where it delivers maximum practical value: confirming a repeatable 'claim → counter-narrative → credibility gap' heuristic that executives can apply independently after the dossier is complete.

phases.context_emphasis: No prior phase. This engine must establish from scratch which concepts are truly load-bearing across the corpus—particularly legitimacy, coherence, and the greenwashing/performativity axis—and rank them by structural weight so every subsequent phase has a stable conceptual spine to build on.
phases.rationale: The brief explicitly calls for this engine as the anchor. It identifies which concepts—legitimacy, greenwashing, coherence, performativity—are load-bearing across all five documents, so the risk audit is grounded in the corpus's own logic rather than in assumptions imported from outside. For an executive audience, this establishes a defensible, evidence-based vocabulary for naming exactly where sustainability claims are structurally exposed.
